findings.issue: Answer vectors imported as ordinary data tables
findings.root_cause: The older table serializer treated matrix input layout tables as data tables. Markdown lost rowspans and CSS bracket borders and made the first row a header. The HTML variant retained the rowspan but lost border styles, leaving a grid instead of vector brackets.
findings.current_capture_reproduction: The active capture extractor reconstructs bracketed matrix layouts from the saved source DOM for all sixteen questions without extraction errors.
findings.why_later_cleanup_missed_it: The 2026-10-30 repair normalized TeX while retaining the pipe-table structure. normalize_matrix_answer_tables can repair the seed but has no production callers; generic normalize_prose does not invoke it.
